hosting.//: Real SPA rewriting, unlike the 404.html fallback GitHub Pages needs: a deep link like /learn/loops returns index.html with a 200 rather than a 404 the browser happens to render.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these, so a URL's contents can never change. Cache them for a year and skip revalidation entirely.
The curriculum and the vendored Python are regenerated on every deploy but keep stable filenames, so they must be revalidated or learners would be stuck on an old build.
The entry point names the current asset bundle; caching it would pin visitors to a stale deploy.

The app renders learner-authored markdown and runs learner Python, so deny framing and MIME sniffing. Deliberately NOT setting COOP/COEP: those would require cross-origin isolation, which blocks the Pyodide fetch from jsDelivr.
